name: mobile-native-design-system
description: Flutter-first native mobile design, component, motion, audit, and typed-token tooling for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Flutter-first mobile UI, motion, tokens, and audits.
interface.longDescription: A mobile-only plugin that routes design direction, component plans, native motion, accessibility, tokens, and screen audits to Flutter first and to React Native, SwiftUI, and Compose adapters when needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $mobile-native-design-system to improve this Flutter screen with native components, motion, accessibility, and typed tokens; do not add a web runtime.
